extracted.intended_audience: project sponsors, interested parties, potential litigants, attorneys, and the public concerned with FTA environmental decisions for listed transit projects
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register notice announcing final FTA environmental actions for two public transportation projects, identifying the legal bases for those actions, the deadline to file claims for judicial review, and where supporting documentation can be found. It serves to activate the statutory limitation on challenges under 23 U.S.C. 139(l).

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation on claims / deadline for judicial review
rubrics_metrics.description: A claim seeking judicial review of FTA actions announced herein for the listed public transportation projects will be barred unless the claim is filed on or before May 18, 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notice activates the statutory limitation period for judicial challenges to the FTA actions described. Interested parties must file any challenges by the stated date or be time-barred.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of the notice (which decisions and laws are covered)
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice applies to all FTA decisions on the listed projects as of the issuance date of this notice and all laws under which such actions were taken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The scope is not limited to a single document; it encompasses all final agency actions taken as described in the project documentation and environmental project files. It does not alter limitation periods for decisions covered by earlier notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory authority for limitation on claims
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The limitation on claims announced in the notice is issued pursuant to 23 U.S.C. 139(l)(1), which governs time limits for judicial review of certain transportation-related environmental decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Laws and statutes under which actions were taken
rubrics_metrics.description: The actions on the projects, as well as the laws under which such actions were taken, are described in the documentation and include, but are not limited to: NEPA (42 U.S.C. 4321-4375), Section 4(f) (49 U.S.C. 303), Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act (54 U.S.C. 306108), the Endangered Species Act (16 U.S.C. 1531), the Clean Water Act (33 U.S.C. 1251), the Uniform Relocation and Real Property Acquisition Policies Act (42 U.S.C. 4601), and the Clean Air Act (42 U.S.C. 7401-7671q).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice signals that final actions were taken under these authorities; challenges to compliance with any of these statutes are subject to the limitation period activated by the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: NEPA documentation requirement / location of supporting files
rubrics_metrics.description: The actions ... are described in the documentation issued in connection with the projects to comply with the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) and in other documents in the FTA environmental project files for the projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interested parties may view the NEPA and supporting documents (e.g., CEs, supporting materials) via the provided project links or contact the project sponsor or relevant FTA Regional Office for more information. Specific CE documents and dates are provided for each project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final agency action: Section 106 No Adverse Effect determination (West Broad Street BRT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final agency action for West Broad Street BRT: Section 106 No Adverse Effect determination, dated July 25, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice lists the Section 106 finding as one of the final actions subject to the limitation period; supporting documentation (Documented Categorical Exclusion dated September 10, 2025) is available at the project link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final agency action: Section 4(f) de minimis impact determination (West Broad Street BRT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final agency action for West Broad Street BRT: Section 4(f) de minimis impact determination, dated October 3, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Section 4(f) de minimis determination is identified as a final action that can be challenged within the statutory time frame activated by this notice. See supporting CE documentation at the provided link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final agency action: Categorical exclusion applicability under 23 CFR 771.118(d) (West Broad Street BRT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final agency action for West Broad Street BRT: determination of the applicability of a categorical exclusion pursuant to 23 CFR 771.118(d), dated October 3, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CE determination and associated documents (Documented Categorical Exclusion dated September 10, 2025) are available at the project's website link. The CE determination itself is a final agency action subject to the limitation period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final agency action: Section 106 No Adverse Effect determination (VIA ART East/West Corridor)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final agency action for VIA ART East/West Corridor Project: Section 106 No Adverse Effect determination, dated October 8, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This Section 106 finding is a listed final action; supporting CE and materials (dated October 31, 2025) are available via the provided project link and are subject to the limitation on claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final agency action: Section 4(f) de minimis impact determination (VIA ART East/West Corridor)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final agency action for VIA ART East/West Corridor Project: Section 4(f) de minimis impact determination, dated November 25, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Section 4(f) de minimis determination is listed among the final actions that may be challenged within the statutory time limit; see the project's CE and supporting materials link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final agency action: Categorical exclusion applicability under 23 CFR 771.118(d) (VIA ART East/West Corridor)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final agency action for VIA ART East/West Corridor Project: determination of the applicability of a categorical exclusion pursuant to 23 CFR 771.118(d), dated November 25, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The CE and supporting materials (Documented Categorical Exclusion and supporting materials dated October 31, 2025) are cited as the basis for the CE determination and are available at the listed project URL.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project description elements included in notice
rubrics_metrics.description: For each project, the notice provides a project name, location, project sponsor, corridor length, description of guideway/lane types, number and features of stations (e.g., Americans with Disabilities Act accessibility, off-board fare collection, transit signal priority), and related infrastructure improvements (e.g., layover facilities, garage upgrades, bicycle lanes, sidewalks, stormwater improvements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The level of project detail identifies the substantive actions and facilities that were evaluated in the environmental determinations; these descriptions point readers to the specific elements covered by the NEPA/Section 106/Section 4(f) findings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supporting documentation availability and URLs
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting documentation: COTA West Broad Bus Rapid Transit Project Documented Categorical Exclusion (CE), dated September 10, 2025, available at https://linkuscolumbus.com/westbroad/. VIA ART CE and supporting materials, dated October 31, 2025, available at https://keepsamoving.com/projects/via-rapid/via-rapid-silver-line/.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice identifies where the CE and associated documents can be viewed and downloaded; these materials are the administrative record for the listed final actions and are the place to review the factual and legal bases for the decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for obtaining further information / contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Interested parties may contact either the project sponsor or the relevant FTA Regional Office for more information. Contact persons listed: Kathryn Loster, Assistant Chief Counsel, (202) 360-2322; Saadat Khan, Environmental Protection Specialist, (202) 366-6385. FTA Regional Office contact information is available at FTA regional offices webpage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice provides named contacts and office location/hours for inquiries; parties should use these contacts to request project files or clarification about the decisions and administrative records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comments status
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice signals that the administrative opportunity for comment on these actions has closed; subsequent challenges must proceed via judicial review within the limitation period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Register legal status / verification guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype Web 2.0 version of the daily Federal Register and is not an official legal edition. Users relying on the material for legal research should verify results against the official print version or the official electronic version on govinfo.gov. Only official editions provide legal notice and judicial notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Citations and legal reliance should be based on the official PDF or govinfo.gov versions; the XML rendition here is informational and should be cross-checked with the official edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation on claims does not alter prior notices' limitation periods
rubrics_metrics.description: This notice does not, however, alter or extend the limitation period for challenges of project decisions subject to previous notices published in the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If prior notices set different limitation periods for certain project decisions, those earlier deadlines remain controlling for those decisions; this notice only activates the limitation period for actions covered by this specific notice.
